findings.description: tools/overview-mcp/README.md (line 142) claims that concurrent overview.sync.now calls return `{ ok: false, error: 'sync already in progress' }`, but the implementation in tools/overview-mcp/src/tools/sync-now.ts (line 62) returns `'another sync in progress'`. Agents that string-match on the documented error message (or the AC text in plan.md) will not detect the single-flight rejection.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the string 'sync already in progress' on line 142 of tools/overview-mcp/README.md with 'another sync in progress' so the documented error matches the actual return value in src/tools/sync-now.ts.
findings.resolution: Replaced "sync already in progress" with "another sync in progress" on README line 142 to match sync-now.ts.

findings.description: tools/overview-mcp/README.md (line 112) states that overview.dev_server.status `Returns the current ProcessManager snapshot and the last 30 lines from each stream.` However, the implementation in tools/overview-mcp/src/tools/dev-server-status.ts (lines 51-53, function `tailLogs`) slices the last 10 lines per stream (`logs.stdout.slice(-10)` / `logs.stderr.slice(-10)`), not 30. Operators relying on the doc to size their log buffers will see 1/3 of the expected output.
findings.suggestedFix: Change 'the last 30 lines from each stream' to 'the last 10 lines from each stream' on line 112 of tools/overview-mcp/README.md, or alternatively update tailLogs in src/tools/dev-server-status.ts to slice -30. The README change is the docs-scope fix; the code change is a separate scope decision.
findings.resolution: Changed "the last 30 lines" to "the last 10 lines" on README line 112 to match tailLogs slice(-10).
